title: Settings

account.title: Account

avatar.permission_message: Camera access is required to take a photo.

email_fixed: Email is set at sign-up and can't be changed here.

groups.comments_description: New comments on issues you're subscribed to.
groups.reactions_description: When someone reacts to an issue you created or a comment you wrote.
groups.updates_description: Edits to title, description, labels, priority, or due date.
groups.new_issues_description: When an issue is created in a project you subscribe to.

server.title: Server settings
server.description: Use Multica Cloud or connect to your own Multica server. Ask your administrator for the API and web addresses.
server.api_help: Backend root address, including a port or base path if needed. A trailing /api is removed because API routes add it automatically.
server.web_help: Address used when copying links or opening Multica in a browser. It may differ from the API address.
server.change_message: You will be signed out. Local drafts and cached workspace data will be cleared. Sign in again on the selected server.
server.invalid: Enter a complete HTTPS address without credentials, a query, or a fragment. Check the host, port, and base path.
server.https_required: HTTP is not supported. Use HTTPS with a certificate trusted by this device.
server.save_failed: Could not save the server settings. Please try again. You may need to sign in again.
server.load_failed: Saved server settings could not be loaded. Check the addresses and save them before signing in.
server.security: Both addresses require HTTPS and a certificate trusted by this device. Changes take effect after saving and remain after restarting the app.
server.attachment_failed: Could not open the attachment. Please try again.
